    Content:
      - Section: General Fields::Application
        RowStart: 1
        ColumnStart: 1
      - Section: GovernanceDB Backlinks::Backlinks
        RowStart: 2
        ColumnStart: 1

        RowStart: 1
        RowSpan: 2
        ColumnStart: 2

  # definition referring to a role with the name "GovernanceDB GF class name". 
  # This is where the fields of the respective class can be customised.
  General Fields:
    Name: ZTSM Application
  GovernanceDB Backlinks:
    Name: GovernanceDB Backlinks
  GovernanceDB Description:
